periods.time: End of volume, during Tokyo command operations

name.zh: 月影总理与一辉归还报告
name.en: Report that Tsukikage and Ikki have returned

periods.location: League Integrated Operations Center; Tsushima Base report
periods.summary: While Tokyo remains under pressure from the Pacific Fleet and Enterprise, the Integrated Operations Center receives an urgent report from Tsushima Base: Prime Minister Bakuya Tsukikage has been protected and is safe. This directly contradicts the U.S. claim that he had been captured and confessed to League-Rebellion collusion. A second report adds that Itsuki's son, Ikki Kurogane, is among the people accompanying Tsukikage.
periods.cause: Unspecified offscreen events bring Tsukikage and Ikki to Tsushima Base while the U.S. invasion is still in progress.
periods.process: The report shocks the command room because the entire U.S. war pretext relied on Tsukikage's alleged capture and statement. Itsuki is further shaken by the news that Ikki is present with the prime minister.
periods.outcome: The volume ends on a sudden reversal of the invasion's stated justification and the re-entry of Ikki into the main conflict.
periods.significance: Final cliffhanger that pivots from the Daien resolution toward the next volume's war and political truth revelations.
